mentions.name: Simple LLM
mentions.description: A language model that runs without a GPU, using Hebbian learning with extreme compression and a built-in Prolog interpreter to achieve reasoning ability.
mentions.source_excerpt: Simple LLM: an LLM which doesn't need a GPU to function. It uses Hebbian learning with extreme compression and attempts to achieve 'reasoning ability' through using a in-built Prolog interpreter. It very much resembles a human being in it's 'thinking mode' so far but still far from perfect.
